title: BanditBox sync op
description: One change to a profile's layout document, made on a TV and sent to the server with POST /api/v1/sync/ops. See schema/README.md for how paths address the document.

opId.description: Unique id made by the TV. Sending the same op twice applies it once.

deviceId.description: Filled in by the server from the device token. Ignored if a TV sends it.

hlc.description: Hybrid logical clock: Unix milliseconds and a counter, zero-padded so the strings sort in time order.

path.description: Where the change applies, for example /profile/name or /rows/favorites/items. Elements of id-keyed arrays (rows, folders) are addressed by id.

value.description: The new value, for set and insert.

after.description: For insert and move into an id-keyed array: the id to place the element after, or null for the start.
